units.statement: The urban ecosystem of Douala supports 72 epiphyte species from 57 genera and 32 families, dominated by Polypodiaceae; casual epiphytes are the most abundant life form (48 species, 66.67% of species; 63.86% of individuals) while true epiphytes are the least (8 species, 11.11%; ~10% of individuals), composed mainly of pteridophytes with Calyptrochilium spp. as the sole Orchidaceae; this richness exceeds that reported for comparable urban forest sites elsewhere.
source_quotes: A total of 72 species of epiphytes were identified, dominated by Polypodiaceae.
belonging to 57 genera grouped into 32 families.
08 species (11.11%) of True epiphytes, 16 species (22.22%) of Hemi-epiphytes, and 48 species (66.67 %) of Casual epiphytes.

units.statement: The host tree inventory recorded 347 phorophyte individuals from 22 species, 17 genera, and 13 families, with Rutaceae the most represented family (6 species); Apocynaceae and Burseraceae were paucispecific (one species each); Elaeis guineensis was the most colonised host supporting 55 epiphyte species, followed by Cocos nucifera and Mangifera indica (27 each), identifying palms as especially important epiphyte hosts.

units.statement: Epiphyte abundance and life-form composition varied spatially across four sectors: 804 individuals were recorded, with the urban sector highest (323) and peri-urban lowest (99); true epiphytes predominated in seaside (75.37%) and peripheral sectors while casual and hemi-epiphytes dominated central industrial (casual 50.84%) and urban (casual 49.85%) sectors, indicating urbanization constrains strict epiphytes; epiphyte abundance was not proportional to host tree density.

units.statement: Epiphyte life forms show vertical segregation on host trees: true epiphytes exhibit an ascending fixation gradient from trunk to crown (upper canopy 80% true) while hemi- and casual epiphytes show a decreasing gradient; the trunk was dominated by 48 casual, 16 hemi-, and 8 true epiphyte species.
source_quotes: True epiphytes showed an ascending gradient of fixation, from trunk to crown, while Hemi and Casual epiphytes had a decreasing gradient of fixation, from crown to trunk.
Trunk was dominated by Casual epiphytes (48 species), Hemi (16 species), and True epiphytes (8 species) (Figure 6).

Upper canopy was colonized by True epiphytes with four species (80%), and Hemi epiphytes (1 species). units.statement: Peripheral areas of Douala, interpreted as the wettest and least industrialised, could serve as conservation sites for epiphytes; epiphytes may persist in fairly stable numbers unless industrial activity and urbanisation intensify, supporting further assessment for conservation.
source_quotes: Indeed, epiphytes are indicators of the humidity of the environment.

It can therefore be said that the peripheral areas of the city of Douala are the wettest, and could constitute a site for the conservation of epiphytes. *Calyptrochilium* spp., the only Orchidaceae species was found in the administrative sector.
The status of epiphytes would also help to identify areas of the city with higher humidity.

The research aim was to
characterize the epiphytic flora of the urban ecosystem of Douala.

anthropogenic activities that take place there.
